run_coco_caption_evaluation: run the coco caption evaluation script with a predictions file and annotation file to compute metrics
run_coco_eval_with_set: run the coco caption evaluation script specifying a custom set like karpathy_test for evaluation
print_metrics_function: print the final model performance metrics including Bleu, METEOR, ROUGE_L, SPICE, and CIDEr scores
review_coco_eval_main: review the main block that loads predictions and ground truth captions then calculates COCO metrics
summarize_coco_eval_script: summarize the coco evaluation script that computes captioning metrics from prediction and annotation files
